assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls (FAR, height, density, green ratio, setbacks, road redlines), ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package is reviewable as a formal AI submission for the provided provisional boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.
assumptions.trigger: Recompute all area- and control-sensitive metrics when official polygons or regulatory conditions arrive.

assumptions.statement: All submitted boundary and key-area polygons are provisional rough polygons from the maintainer provisional set (provisional_constraint, official_boundary=false).
assumptions.impact: site_area_sqm, key-area areas, all land-use ratios, and building ratios are working values for intake comparison, not official scoring areas.
assumptions.trigger: Replace with official polygons and rerun geometry generation, metrics, figures, HTML, and self-check.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are concept-level placeholders generated deterministically inside land-use parcels; no parcel-level retain/renovate/demolish conclusions are implied.
assumptions.impact: building_footprint_ratio is a concept ratio, not a statutory building coverage ratio.
assumptions.trigger: Existing-building survey and ownership data required for any parcel-level conclusion.

assumptions.statement: Road centerlines are conceptual design lines inside road land-use cells; they are not road redlines, cross-sections, or engineering alignments.
assumptions.impact: road_ratio and spine_length_m are concept metrics.
assumptions.trigger: Official road redlines and cross-section data required before engineering use.

assumptions.statement: Heritage protection scopes and construction-control zones (e.g., Qinghuayuan Station site) follow cultural-relic authority publications; no heritage GIS layer is registered in the site package.
assumptions.impact: Landmark and cultural proposals are directional concepts; any physical intervention requires heritage approval.
assumptions.trigger: Register official heritage GIS layers and re-check all landmark positions.

assumptions.statement: All 12 scenario cards are conceptual and not deployed, not authorized, not operational; test/validation scenarios require permits, safety assessment, and human oversight before any pilot.
assumptions.impact: Scenario claims carry no deployment commitment.
assumptions.trigger: Scenario pilots require official permits and professional safety reviews.
